**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Skip comment rows during the TSV preflight**

When the shared extra TSV contains a supported comment row such as `#\tnote about \`code\``, this scan treats the comment's second field as a disposition and aborts the entire run even though every actual disposition is safe. `fill_sweep.py:54` explicitly ignores lines beginning with `#`, so the preflight should apply the same rule before checking `$2`.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
